name: Xiaomi
summary:
Xiaomi explores humanoid robotics through CyberOne, a research platform combining mechanical actuation, whole-body control and human interaction. The robot brings together Xiaomi-developed motion modules, depth vision and audio processing in a full-size bipedal body.

Its Mi Sense visual system supports perception of the surrounding environment, while microphones, a display and interactive software provide channels for communicating with people. CyberOne's development addresses both movement and sensing, connecting the physical challenges of balance and articulated motion with the interpretation of visual and audio information. It represents Xiaomi's broader research into intelligent robots alongside its consumer technology business.
